items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: But anyway, we got to be rather good friends, she and I; in fact, when she got ready to get married, I helped to sponsor her wedding.

ctx.x: And so here I come out of the clear blue sky saying to her, "This is your father". So anyway, it was a big shock to her; it really shook her up very bad, and I felt awful bad about it, and I gave her mother hell because I told her that I didn't think that was right, for her to allow me to walk in there without letting me know that this kid didn't know who I was, because I would have turned it around, and said let her find out her way who I am. it would be fine to go along with who she said I was. You know?
But anyway, we got to be rather good friends, she and I; in fact, when she got ready to get married, I helped to sponsor her wedding. Then the following year ...
Wait, did we record her name on here?
